features.text: Patient reports increased fatigue, which he attributes to age or daily exertion.
Patient mentions that after a long bike ride, he experiences significant fatigue and needs to rest immediately.
Patient rides a road bike for 20 to 30 miles, but cannot complete 40 miles as he used to.
Patient feels he is no longer able to outpace his friend Tyler, who now waits for him during rides.
Patient is concerned about pursed lips breathing, though no wheezing is reported.
Patient has a nodule on the epididymis of the right testicle.
Patient does not have a history of vasectomy.
Patient does not have a history of depression and reports being generally happy.
Patient does not have a history of snoring or sleep apnea, though he believes he snores slightly.
Patient has a history of aortic valve replacement and ascending aortic aneurysm repair on 1/22/2013.
Patient has a history of elevated alkaline phosphatase (156) on 4/10/2021.
Patient has a history of elevated total cholesterol (247), LDL (166), and normal HDL (66) and triglycerides (74) on 4/10/2021.
Patient has a history of normal TSH (2.68) on 4/10/2021.
Patient has a history of normal CBC on 4/10/2021.
Patient has a history of vitamin D level at the high end of normal (94) on 4/10/2021.
Patient received both doses of the COVID-19 vaccine: first on 1/15/2021 and second on 2/5/2021.
Patient sleeps 6 to 7 hours per night, though the exact time varies.
Patient makes reservations twice a week for a 5:45 AM swim.
Patient gets out of bed early to be at work by 7:00 AM and tries to work out in the morning.
Patient avoids going to Hopkins due to the stress involved.
Patient prefers to receive follow-ups intermittently at his current location rather than at Hopkins.
Patient prefers to have an echocardiogram and stress test ordered today.
